meta.name: linkedin-ads-bidding
meta.description: Configure LinkedIn Ads bidding strategies, budget allocation, and cost optimization. Use when the user asks about LinkedIn bidding, manual vs automated bidding, LinkedIn CPM, CPC, CPV, ad budget allocation, daily budget, bid adjustments, cost per lead, or LinkedIn ad spend optimization. Triggers on "LinkedIn bidding", "manual bidding", "automated bidding", "CPM", "CPC", "CPV", "ad budget", "bid adjustment", "cost per lead", "LinkedIn spend". Do NOT use for campaign structure (use campaign-setup) or creative questions (use creative/copy).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 配置并优化 LinkedIn Ads 出价策略与广告预算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 LinkedIn 上管理广告出价和预算分配
copy.tagline_en: Configure and optimize LinkedIn Ads bidding strategies and budgets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage LinkedIn ad bidding and budget allocation

howto.what: 当用户询问LinkedIn广告竞价时，Claude会提供手动/自动竞价策略选择、预算分配建议（按漏斗分层）、出价调整公式及每日预算监控方法。
howto.when: 当用户提到“LinkedIn竞价”、“手动竞价”、“自动竞价”等关键词，或询问预算分配、出价调整时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置LinkedIn手动竞价策略，初始出价高于最低值。
say.note: Claude会给出竞价选择和初始出价建议。

say.text: 每月5000美元LinkedIn预算如何分配到各漏斗层？
say.note: Claude会按50/25/25比例分配并说明测试预算。

say.text: LinkedIn广告出价过低导致花费不足怎么办？
say.note: Claude会建议根据每日花费与预算差值调高出价。

howto.what_en: When asked about LinkedIn Ads bidding, Claude provides manual/automated strategy selection, budget allocation by funnel layer, daily bid adjustment formula, and spend monitoring guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user mentions 'LinkedIn bidding', 'manual bidding', 'automated bidding', or asks about budget allocation, bid adjustment, or cost optimization.

say_en.text: Set up manual LinkedIn bidding with an initial bid above minimum.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest strategy and starting bid.

say_en.text: How to allocate a $5K/month LinkedIn budget across funnel layers?
say_en.note: Claude will propose 50/25/25 split and testing budget.

say_en.text: What if LinkedIn ad spend is too low due to low bids?
say_en.note: Claude will recommend increasing bids based on spend vs budget gap.
